scope: Generalized harmonic and form vocabulary, not transcriptions of named songs.

progressions.variationPolicy: Continue through ii7-V7-I or alter bass/inversion before repeating.
progressions.source: The Royal Road Progression in Japanese Popular Music; related Japanese-pop corpus studies

progressions.variationPolicy: Reserve the full tonic cadence for a section boundary; avoid resolving every four bars.
Use inversions and rhythmic displacement; do not use as the only progression in all sections.
Keep upper voices stepwise and let the bass define inversions.
Increase register and rhythmic activity toward V; withhold the chorus tonic until the downbeat.

arrangementConstraint: A complete form does not imply all roles play continuously. Role activation and rhythmic density must change at section boundaries.
